tools.name: get_voice
tools.description: Get one voice's full profile: its VOICE.md, every source studied with a note on what it shows, the observations drawn from them, an iconic example, the licence and the attribution line. Profiles are unofficial studies of public writing technique; the people named did not write or endorse them.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Compare the voice IDs your agent has cached with the current release: voices added, voices re-studied as a new edition, and voices removed. Pass an empty list to receive every voice as added.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_voices · Public sink: search_voices · Destructive: get_voice_packet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_voices · Public sink: search_voices · Destructive: get_voice_packet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_voice" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
